# SkatMind rename fixtures

These files are retained exact pre-rename v0.17-format inputs for Issue #205.
They intentionally contain old document kinds and fingerprint domains so strict
legacy Load/Resume, mixed-profile rejection, no-mutation-on-Load, canonical
explicit Save, and opaque Learning Corpus object-ID behavior remain executable.

They are compatibility fixtures, not current examples. New writers must never
emit these legacy identities.
